toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create the complete standalone HTML page requested: realtime rotating Gouraud shaded cube, Canvas 2D only, no libraries/assets/fonts/network. Polished dark navy technical exhibit with restrained cyan accents, large central canvas, title 'GOURAUD / light in motion', compact live FPS indicator, explanatory footer and real buttons for wireframe W and pause P. Responsive full viewport with accessible buttons. All CSS and JS inline. Implement actual CPU triangle rasterizer with ImageData, float depth buffer, barycentric color interpolation (prefer perspective correct using reciprocal depth), bounds clipped to viewport and degenerate triangle guard. Cap internal rendering size around 800x600 for realtime performance, scale canvas CSS appropriately. Background can be CSS with a subtle grid; image buffer should have dark background or transparent unused pixels. Eight cube vertices ±1, six explicitly outward-wound quads split into two triangles each. Explicit 3x3 rotation matrices about X Y Z and matrix multiplication, transform vertices and normals, perspective camera at origin with cube translated to z=5.5; project with screen y inverted. Backface cull using outward face normal dot face center in camera coordinates <0 for visible faces, not an ambiguous screen winding convention. Compute per-vertex Lambert dot(normalize(rotated vertex as smooth vertex normal), normalize(lightPosition - transformedVertex)) plus ambient, optionally attenuation, multiplied by each face's distinct muted saturated teal/blue/violet base color. Colors calculated only at vertices then interpolated within rasterizer, do NOT use canvas linear gradients as a fake Gouraud substitute. Depth test interpolated reciprocal z. Animate cube angles and an orbiting point light using accumulated simulation time and clamped requestAnimationFrame delta. Display moving point light as small glowing marker projected into canvas, ideally depth aware; source orbit stays positive camera z. Optional subtle axis ornament. Wireframe toggle draws visible face outlines AND triangle diagonals over filled shading using 2D strokes. P and pause button freeze both cube and light but keep animation scheduling and FPS measurement active. Ignore repeated keydown and modifier keys. Display current averaged actual frame FPS updated about every 0.4 second. Resize safely via ResizeObserver or window resize, preserve state. Start animation immediately and have working button aria-pressed state/status labels. Include concise English comments documenting pipeline and interpolation. Produce finished file, no TODOs."}
